sn35.236:0.3: The Simile of Hands and Feet (1)
sn35.236:1.1: “Bhikkhus, when there are hands, picking up and putting down are discerned.
sn35.236:1.2: When there are feet, coming and going are discerned.
sn35.236:1.3: When there are limbs, bending and stretching are discerned.
sn35.236:1.4: When there is the belly, hunger and thirst are discerned.
sn35.236:1.5: “So too, bhikkhus, when there is the eye, pleasure and pain arise internally with eye-contact as condition.
sn35.236:1.6: When there is the ear, pleasure and pain arise internally with ear-contact as condition….
sn35.236:1.7: When there is the mind, pleasure and pain arise internally with mind-contact as condition.
sn35.236:2.1: “When, bhikkhus, there are no hands, picking up and putting down are not discerned.
sn35.236:2.2: When there are no feet, coming and going are not discerned.
sn35.236:2.3: When there are no limbs, bending and stretching are not discerned.
sn35.236:2.4: When there is no belly, hunger and thirst are not discerned.
sn35.236:2.5: “So too, bhikkhus, when there is no eye, no pleasure and pain arise internally with eye-contact as condition.
sn35.236:2.6: When there is no ear, no pleasure and pain arise internally with ear-contact as condition….
sn35.236:2.7: When there is no mind, no pleasure and pain arise internally with mind-contact as condition.”
